title: Prepositions of Motion
description: В/на vs. из/с with verbs of motion
descriptionRussian: В/на против из/с с глаголами движения
intro: Russian distinguishes between motion TO a place and motion FROM a place. When going TO somewhere, use в + accusative (into enclosed spaces) or на + accusative (onto surfaces, events, open areas). When coming FROM somewhere, use the corresponding 'из' (out of) with genitive for в-destinations, and 'с' (off of) with genitive for на-destinations. This в↔из and на↔с pairing is essential for correct Russian!
rules: TO enclosed spaces: в + accusative: Я иду в школу. (I'm going to school.)
FROM enclosed spaces: из + genitive: Я иду из школы. (I'm coming from school.)
TO surfaces/events: на + accusative: Я иду на работу. (I'm going to work.)
FROM surfaces/events: с + genitive: Я иду с работы. (I'm coming from work.)
examples: Я еду в Москву. (I'm going to Moscow.), в + acc
Она приехала из Москвы. (She came from Moscow.), из + gen
Мы идём на концерт. (We're going to the concert.), на + acc
Они вернулись с концерта. (They returned from the concert.), с + gen

items.prompt: Я иду _____ школу. (I'm going to school.)
Она идёт _____ работу. (She's going to work.)
Мы едем _____ Москву. (We're going to Moscow.)
items.explanation: Going TO a city: в Москву.

items.prompt: Он вернулся _____ школы. (He returned from school.)
Она пришла _____ работы. (She came from work.)
Они приехали _____ Петербурга. (They arrived from St. Petersburg.)
items.explanation: Coming FROM a city (в→из): из Петербурга.

items.prompt: Дети идут _____ концерт. (The children are going to the concert.)
items.promptEnglish: The children are going to the concert.
items.explanation: Going TO an event: на концерт.

items.prompt: Мы вернулись _____ концерта. (We returned from the concert.)
items.explanation: Coming FROM an event (на→с): с концерта.

items.prompt: Студенты идут _____ университет. (The students are going to the university.)
items.promptEnglish: The students are going to the university.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Motion prepositions: в/из for enclosed spaces, на/с for surfaces/events
hints: Going TO the airport (enclosed space). Which preposition: в or на?
Coming FROM school. School uses в, so the opposite is which preposition?
Coming FROM work. Work uses на, so the opposite is which preposition?
Going TO a concert (event). Events use which preposition: в or на?
Returning FROM Moscow (city). Cities use в, so the opposite is which preposition?
explanations: Аэропорт is an enclosed space → в аэропорт (в + accusative).
School uses в, so FROM school uses из: из школы (из + genitive).
Work uses на, so FROM work uses с: с работы (с + genitive).
Events use на: на концерт (на + accusative).
Cities use в, so FROM a city uses из: из Москвы (из + genitive).

minimalPairs.explanation: Going TO = в + accusative: в магазин.
Coming FROM = из + genitive: из магазина.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: в/из destinations or на/с destinations?

Из школы, из Москвы, из магазина.
